title: Decide the style up front (mood, colors, camera, pacing, and reference assets)…
content:
Decide the style up front (mood, colors, camera, pacing, and reference assets) before generating multi-shot videos with Seedance 2.5.  
Use Flova Agent to convert your initial idea into a script and storyboard to structure multi-shot Seedance 2.5 generation.  
Review and refine the Prompt Draft before generating, then generate the project step-by-step using the appropriate models per shot.  
Iterate by leaving comments to fix off-style shots, then save the resulting assets or the entire workflow for reuse.  
Stress-test Seedance 2.5 coherence by generating a full ensemble group scene with multiple recurring faces to check identity stability across shots.
